title: Aromatic Creamy Korean Green Beans Dosirak
description: A peppery and creamy Korean dish featuring green beans, perfect for a sick day, made in a dosirak format and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the green beans and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang, soy sauce, and coconut cream.
Pour the sauce over the green beans and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the green beans in a dosirak container, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
